integrity: The universal result follows from an exact conditional law for a uniform prefix subset under an upper-record event. Exhaustive exact enumeration and independent finite-sum checks are supplementary rather than substitutes for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes a uniform random permutation.
The Spearman specialization assumes complete rankings without ties.
An equivalent elementary identity may occur in older unindexed permutation-record literature.
title: A local record covariance law for linear rank scores
